Honest Talk

Myths vs reality

Myth

“Affiliate marketing is instant money.”

Reality

It takes learning, consistency and effort. That’s why we teach the basics first.

Myth

“You must be tech-savvy.”

Reality

Our lessons are beginner-friendly and built around your smartphone.

Frequently asked questions

Is the WhatsApp class really free?

Yes. Joining the learning community is free, and you’ll receive training information, updates and tips there.

Do I need experience?

No. The AMB training starts from the fundamentals and requires no previous experience.

What do I need to start?

A smartphone, an internet connection and the willingness to learn.

Will I definitely make money?

No one can promise that. Affiliate marketing does not guarantee income. Results depend on your effort, skills and strategy.

How do I join?

Tap any “Join Our WhatsApp Class” button on this page and you’ll be taken straight to the group.
